data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions.

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.description: The portal stores supplier compliance documents in the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier compliance paperwork, including insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details.

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description states: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The runbook states: "the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These claims do not establish a single encryption-in-transit value.

data_flows.name: load data extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the extract file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write supplier records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes records from the extract into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database holds confidential data because it stores supplier records from the extract.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the supplier master service writes supplier records into the database, with the extract containing supplier data including staff contact details.
